VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report describes a plausible root cause and claims all 37 tests pass, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require that "all 37 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
